videos.title: 5 Isekai Anime You Missed in 2023
videos.desc: Hidden gems from last year that deserve a watch.
videos.intro: Everyone talks about Re:Zero and Mushoku Tensei, but 2023 had some incredible isekai that flew under the radar. Let's count down five you might have missed.
videos.outro: Which of these hidden gems are you adding to your watchlist? Comment below and subscribe for more isekai recommendations.

entries.heading: 5. The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
entries.script: A classic overpowered protagonist story with stunning ice magic animation and a surprisingly wholesome harem dynamic.

entries.heading: 4. Reborn as a Vending Machine
entries.script: Absurd premise, heartfelt execution. Boxxo the vending machine becomes a guardian for a fantasy village — it's weirder and better than it sounds.

entries.heading: 3. Farming Life in Another World
entries.script: No demon lord, no saving the world — just a former salaryman building a cozy farm with help from friendly monsters. Pure comfort viewing.

entries.heading: 2. The Great Cleric
entries.script: Salaryman reincarnates as a healer and applies corporate efficiency to adventuring. Smart, funny, and refreshingly low-stakes.

entries.heading: 1. Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
entries.script: Overpowered but grounded. The MC uses modern knowledge to reform his territory while navigating noble politics — think Realist Hero but more personal.
